newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish 12 bln skr T-bill auction oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Swedish 12 bln skr T-bill auction oversubscribed.

text.p: An auction of 12 billion crowns of treasury bills was heavily oversubscribed, receiving bids of 25.9 billion crowns, the National Debt Office said on Wednesday.
The average accepted rate in an auction of two billion crowns of three-month Treasury bills was 3.69 percent, the office said. It received 27 bids worth 3.28 billion crowns and accepted 11 bids.
In an auction of three billion crowns of six month paper, the average accepted rate was 3.77 percent. The office received 32 bids worth six billion crowns and accepted six bids.

The office said it received 96 bids totalling 16.65 billion crowns in an auction of one-year T-bills worth seven billion crowns, and accepted 31 bids. The average accepted rate was 3.95 percent. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1017
